name: The Shift: One Nurse, Twelve Hours, Four Patients
seoTitle: The Shift Book: One Nurse, Twelve Hours
metaDescription: The Shift follows one nurse through a 12 hour shift and four patients' lives. A meaningful read for nurses, students, and family who want insight.
summary: A book that walks through one nurse's 12 hour shift and four patients. A meaningful read for anyone who loves, or is becoming, a nurse.
whyItWorks: Few gifts capture the reality of nursing as directly as a book built around a single shift. Twelve hours, four patients, and all the small decisions in between: it is the day nurses actually live, rather than the version on television. For a working nurse, reading it can feel like being understood. For a student, it is a preview of what is coming.

It is also one of the better gifts for the people around a nurse. A spouse or parent who wonders why their nurse comes home so drained might finish it with a new respect for the job. Consider giving it to a new grad along with a note about how proud you are, or to a nursing school friend as a reminder of why they started. It also tends to stick with readers, which is part of why it makes such a thoughtful present for someone at the start of their career or deep into it.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for format, since the paperback may also come in other editions.
A thoughtful choice for the family of a nurse who wants to understand the work.
Works well with a bookmark and a handwritten note for a graduation gift.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes. It gives a grounded look at a real shift and can be encouraging for someone heading into the profession.

faq.q: Is it too heavy a read for a tired nurse?
faq.a: It deals with patients' real lives, so it can be emotional. Many nurses still find it meaningful, but a lighter read may suit someone who wants pure escape.
